native_selection_rule: First new snapshot, maximum parent fraction, minimum/maximum actual wrist flexion, final snapshot; duplicate state IDs run once.
hardware_native_selection_rule: First/last completed hardware snapshots plus the selected material snapshot IDs that have a hardware result; duplicate IDs run once, two groups per state.
metric_selection_rule: Eight free housing arcs at maximum parent fraction and at maximum negative wrist flexion (or final snapshot if no negative wrist snapshot), duplicate IDs once.
